markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (54%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Invasive · Careful review
Invasive (41%) is in the 90% conformal set [F1]; bottom-row regions score strongly invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 54%, Invasive 41%, InSitu 4% | Close call |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (90%) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.95 / 90th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 3 of 5 Benign [F5] | Modest support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · Well above typical; bottom row · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 3) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Moderate score, one region · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 8, 9, 10) · ↑ invasive · Elevated; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Necrosis (3/20) and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 8–11 each score ≥98% invasive on the per-region probe, yet the image-level call is Benign.

## Check on the slide
1. **8, 9, 10, 11** Confirm invasion and necrosis; this row overlaps the inferior margin flagged tumor-positive (simulated).
2. **1, 2, 3** Confirm benign gland architecture; these regions associate with lower invasive likelihood.
3. **4** Look for atypical cells confined within ducts; concept spot check only 12/20.
